title: [CINEMATIC SETUP]
content:
[CINEMATIC SETUP]
Film Style: Photorealistic 4K fixed security camera footage, sci-fi thriller, low-light sensor noise, desaturated cold palette with a single overhead LED tube.
Lens: 35mm fixed surveillance lens, locked mounting position, slight wide-angle.
Color Grade: Cold teal-gray shadows, pale skin under hard toplight; UI elements render in alarm red.
Camera Behavior: Locked-off static frame, no camera movement — all motion within the scene and the interface.
Audio Style: Low electrical hum, buzzing fluorescent, muffled garage reverb, harsh digital alarm tones.

[IMAGE REFERENCES]
@image1: A young East Asian woman with a low ponytail, olive utility jacket over gray tank top, standing in a dim underground parking garage looking up directly into the camera, with a flat 2D red surveillance interface overlaid: header "LEVEL B3 — CAM 09", timestamp, red bounding box on her face labeled "SUBJECT — MATCH 98.7%", grayscale face crop upper right with ID "S-4471", bold red text "ALERT — FLAGGED", REC indicator. Preserve this exact composition, character, and UI layout as the starting frame.

[TIMELINE SECOND BY SECOND]
0-3s: Continuation. Static medium-wide shot. The woman stands motionless, staring up into the lens, chest rising with slow breaths. The overhead LED tube flickers twice. The red REC dot blinks steadily. Timestamp digits tick forward. Low hum, fluorescent buzz.
3-6s: Static medium-wide shot. The ALERT — FLAGGED text begins strobing in rhythmic pulses. The red bounding box tightens around her face, match percentage ticking upward. She slowly lowers her chin, eyes staying fixed on the camera, expression hardening. Rising alarm tone under the hum.
6-10s: Static medium-wide shot. She turns and walks calmly out of frame right, passing between parked cars into shadow. The red bounding box tracks her face until she exits, then the box snaps back to frame center and flickers, searching empty space. ALERT text keeps strobing over the empty garage. Footsteps echo, receding, alarm tone continuing over silence.

[STYLE & QUALITY BOOSTERS]
UI elements remain flat 2D screen-space graphics, sharp legible text, no warping, no drift into the scene. Locked camera, zero camera movement. Only one person in the garage, no extra figures, no headlights, no extra particles. Stable character features, movie-level facial consistency, coherent low-light physics.

[CINEMATIC SETUP]

Color Grade: 冷たいティールグレーの影、硬いトップライトの下の淡い肌色；UI要素はアラームレッドでレンダリング。
Camera Behavior: ロックオフされた静止フレーム、カメラの動きなし — シーン内とインターフェース内のすべての動き。
Audio Style: 低い電気のハム音、蛍光灯のブーン音、こもったガレージのリバーブ、厳しいデジタルアラーム音。

[IMAGE REFERENCES]
@image1: 低いポニーテールの若い東アジア系女性、オリーブのユーティリティジャケットをグレーのタンクトップの上に着て、薄暗い地下駐車場でカメラを見上げて立っている。平坦な2Dの赤い監視インターフェースがオーバーレイされている：ヘッダー「LEVEL B3 — CAM 09」、タイムスタンプ、彼女の顔にラベル付けされた赤い境界ボックス「SUBJECT — MATCH 98.7%」、右上にID「S-4471」のグレースケールの顔のクロップ、太字の赤いテキスト「ALERT — FLAGGED」、RECインジケーター。この正確な構成、キャラクター、UIレイアウトを開始フレームとして保持。

[STYLE & QUALITY BOOSTERS]
UI要素は平坦な2Dスクリーンスペースグラフィックのまま、シャープで読みやすいテキスト、歪みなし、シーンへのドリフトなし。固定カメラ、カメラの動きゼロ。ガレージには一人だけ、余分な人物なし、ヘッドライトなし、余分な粒子なし。安定したキャラクターの特徴、映画レベルの顔の一貫性、一貫した低照度物理学。
